retrieval_query: Are results reported only on English data?
answer: Yes. The results are reported only on English data: the authors filter the IRA dataset to focus on accounts that use English as their main language [4], and they further remove non-English tweets from these accounts, keeping only tweets originally posted by them [9]. This English-only filtering reflects their goal of detecting Russian accounts that mimic regular US users [9], and regular accounts were likewise selected with US location and English as the Twitter interface language [10].
